material.description:
Row gm-instruction-panics-nested-runtime (executor drain-gm-4) is blocked, not fixed in this lane.
Live: gm.instruction on /workspace/oscraft still returns error_code none and "dispatch panicked: Cannot start a runtime from within a runtime" (dispatch 1792906578323-5331-b923e9fe52e1511f). codeinsight find/callers panic the same way (1792906356625-5024-92b45da4bf0ce63e, 1792906375316-5074-c25c0813fe55a5d5).
Location: the nested block_on is agentplug-host crates/agentplug-host/src/registry.rs block_on_component (local 3ced566e, lines 1647-1652, callers 1807 and 2045). gm-mcp source has no block_on or Runtime::new, so the row's file premise is wrong.
Upstream: agentplug main e17a906 already has the fix 085771db ("Run component dispatch on a helper thread when a runtime is entered"): block_on_component checks Handle::try_current and runs block_on on a scoped thread. Upstream gm main c3af980 pins agentplug e17a906.
External fact: the served build does not carry 085771db. Local /workspace/gm is 3185 commits behind origin (HEAD 39b3e13), and its agentplug submodule is at 3ced566e, which lacks the fix. git_pull ff_only is refused pull_blocked_by_local_changes (1792906525050-5178-79e5e4fa3fbc6fdb) because other lanes hold staged or modified paths (skills/gm, skills/gm-continue, skills/gm-hop, skills/gm-orchestrate, skills/manifest.sha256, scripts/check-staged-secrets.mjs).
Clearing action: once the other lanes commit those paths, fast-forward the gm checkout to origin main c3af980 so agentplug is at e17a906, let the runner serve that build, then run gm.instruction on /workspace/oscraft under session verify-gm-instruction-panics-nested-runtime and expect a prose reply with no panic. No edit from this row is needed.
Receipts: /workspace/oscraft/.gm/receipts/gm-instruction-panics-nested-runtime/01-SPECIFY.md, 02-ELIMINATE.md, 03-HANDOFF.md, 04-DREAM.md.
